findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_transfer_quote · Private data: get_transfer_quote, list_tours, start_tour_booking, get_booking_terms · Public sink: find_transfer_destination, get_transfer_quote, start_transfer_booking.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_transfer_quote · Private data: get_transfer_quote, list_tours, start_tour_booking, get_booking_terms · Public sink: find_transfer_destination, get_transfer_quote, start_transfer_booking

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
